Metadata.Purpose: Neutral starter configuration for executive-summary consultant input across AD migration assessments.
Metadata.ReuseGuidance: Copy this file for each engagement, update Metadata.CustomerName, adjust Defaults for the delivery style you want, and add PerForest entries for each source or target forest.

Defaults.ScopeNote: Migration scope should be confirmed with business, application, and identity stakeholders before final wave planning is approved.
Defaults.DnsOverlapAssessment: No automated DNS zone overlap analysis was performed in this discovery set. Validate namespace ownership, conditional forwarders, suffix routing, and application name-resolution dependencies during migration planning.
Defaults.HybridIdentityConsiderations: Hybrid identity was not directly assessed in this AD-only discovery run. Confirm Entra Connect or Cloud Sync topology, federation assumptions, tenant alignment, and source-of-authority ownership separately.

RecommendedMigrationApproach.DirectoryMigrationTool: ADMT inter-forest or equivalent inter-forest directory migration tooling
RecommendedMigrationApproach.Notes: Use pilot waves for privileged accounts, service accounts, and representative user and device cohorts before broader migration waves.

AdditionalComplexityDrivers: Application authentication and service dependency mapping should be completed before cutover sequencing is finalized.
Namespace normalization and target landing-zone standards should be reviewed before broad migration waves begin.
AdditionalRisks: Consultant review is still required for DNS forwarding, namespace overlap, and application authentication dependencies.
Business-unit migration waves and rollback expectations should be confirmed before execution planning is finalized.
